mapper.select:
WITH RECURSIVE recursive_dict AS ( SELECT
FROM sys_dict WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} UNION ALL SELECT sd.* FROM sys_dict sd INNER JOIN recursive_dict rd ON sd.parent_id = rd.id ) SELECT
FROM recursive_dict where forbidden = 0 and delete_time = 0
mapper.insert: insert into sys_dict (id, app_id, feat_code, value_str, value_cn, dict_type, parent_id, id_path, forbidden, create_user, update_user, show_order) select #{dict.id}, #{dict.appId}, #{dict.featCode}, #{dict.valueStr}, #{dict.valueCn}, #{dict.dictType}, #{dict.parentId}, #{dict.idPath}, #{dict.forbidden}, #{dict.createUser}, #{dict.createUser}, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(show_order), 0) + 1 from sys_dict where parent_id = #{dict.parentId})
mapper.update: update sys_dict set id_path = replace(id_path, #{oldPath}, #{newPath}) where id_path like concat(#{oldPath}, '%') and delete_time = 0
